id: title:CShine612:compare ai task instructions with past versions

review.posthog_relevance: Adds frontend UI and state management for HogFlow workflow revision comparison, including HogQL query loading and PostHog analytics event capture.
review.reason: Adds a new workflow revision comparison feature with a dedicated UI component, state management, HogQL query loading, and PostHog analytics event capture. The chunk includes the complete implementation of the comparison component, the conditional rendering of the comparison UI, and the associated state management and HogQL queries. This is a substantive, bounded capability addition
review.uncertainty: The chunk does not include the backend implementation, API endpoints, or workflow execution and revision storage logic, so the tier is not raised to 3.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the backend implementation, API endpoints, or the workflow execution and revision storage logic. The frontend hunk P1.F1.H1 and P1.F1.H2 show the UI and conditional rendering, P1.F2.H1 shows the complete UI implementation, P1.F3.H1 shows the diff editor, and P1.F4.H1 shows tests. Without the backend, the actual retrieval and storage of workflow revisions

observations.behavior: Adds an import for AiTaskInstructionsCompare component.
observations.posthog_connection: Connects the workflow step configuration UI to a new comparison component.

observations.behavior: Renders AiTaskInstructionsCompare conditionally when the workflow step uses the 'template-posthog-create-task' template, passing the actionId.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows workflow steps using the AI task template to display instructions comparison.

observations.behavior: Implements the AiTaskInstructionsCompare component, which checks workflow status, retrieves live and current prompts, and renders a comparison UI with a dropdown to select a past version or the live version, including loading and error states.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides the UI for comparing AI task instructions against a selected version, including loading and error states.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a complete file addition, not a hunk. No supplied hunk IDs exist, so no observations can be produced. No tier or score is assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a new Kea logic module, aiTaskInstructionsCompareLogic, to products/workflows/frontend, including state, loaders, selectors, and listeners for comparing HogFlow revision versions.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides a UI and workflow for comparing HogFlow revision versions, including loading revision lists and individual revisions, selecting versions, and capturing PostHog analytics events when comparisons occur.
